title: Conveyor Motor Safety Latch
source_reference: 自主构思：输送线电机启停与安全联锁
requirements: Implement a conveyor motor function block. A start command latches motorRun when stop, emergencyStop and overload are FALSE. stop or emergencyStop stops the motor immediately. overload stops the motor and latches fault. reset clears fault only when overload is FALSE. The motor cannot run while fault is TRUE.

creation_process: 从常见输送线启停回路抽象出启动保持、停止和过载保护
human_modifications: 将安全输入优先级和故障复位条件写成确定规则
review_process: 检查所有输入均可由常见 PLC 数字量模块提供
检查急停、过载时输出必定断开

plc_rationale: 输送线电机是典型 PLC 离散控制对象，启停保持、安全联锁和故障锁存可直接映射到现场 I/O。

notes: 接口仅使用基础类型，适合首版单 POU harness。
